review_notes: Segment 1: Several longer Sanskrit compounds and phrases were left as in the raw transcript because their intended forms were not unambiguously clear (examples: 'प्राक् दारपरिग्रहात्', 'पुत्रं दीप्रकारं', 'मृषैव', 'अश्रुतं बुद्धेश्च ...'). Please have a Sanskrit/Vedanta specialist verify these segments against the lecture audio or source text.

Segment 1: The segment contains extended quoted/sanskritized material (Shatapatha Brāhmaṇa excerpt). I corrected obvious OCR/ASR tokenization errors and evident misspellings only; preserve original wording elsewhere to avoid altering doctrinal meaning.

Segment 2: Several Sanskrit phrases appear garbled or uncertain (e.g., the opening phrase 'यथा भगवतो वासुदेवस्य', the long clause about 'अग्निहोत्रादि...', and the passage 'उद्धरणमपश्यन् ... उद्धिधारयिषुः आत्मज्ञानाय अवतारयन्नाह'). These may need a subject-matter expert to verify exact shloka/phrasing.
Segment 2: The term 'पचपन श्लोकों' is unclear — might be an ASR error for a numeric or specific phrase (e.g., 'पञ्चपञ्च' or 'पचपनवें'); please verify against the audio or source text.
Segment 2: The mixed Hindi-English sentence 'सो ज्ञानकर्म के समुच्चय का भगवान् भाष्यकार शास्त्रतः विरोध करते हैं।' is syntactically odd; confirm original wording if exact phrasing is important.

Segment 3: Several short Sanskrit/Sanskritic phrases appear garbled or uncertain and may need human verification for precise spelling/inflection: "सर्वाणि कर्माणि श्रौतादीनि दर्शितानि कस्य? अविद्या कामवतः।", "तेभ्यो व्युत्थाय प्रव्रजन्तीति व्युत्थानं विहितम्।", and "व्युत्थानं तेज्भ्यो व्युत्थाय परिव्रजन्ति, ... आत्मानम् एव लोकम् इच्छतः।" Preserve as in transcript because corrections could change doctrinal meaning; please review against the speaker's source notes if needed.

Segment 4: Several quoted archaic/Awadhi lines (e.g., the Tulsi-related lines 'बिनु बिराग सन्न्यासी। श्रीहत भए जोग उपहासी।' and the bow-related lines 'रहा उठाइ चढ़ावउँ भाई, तिल भर भूमि न सकउँ डराई। / तिलभर भूमि न सकौटराई') appear to be in dialect/old Hindi and contain non-standard spellings; they were left as in the original because intended exact wording is uncertain and changes could alter the quotation.

Segment 4: The Sanskrit/Gītā-related phrase 'एषा तेऽभिहिता सांख्ये बुद्धिरयोगे त्विमां शृणु।' was preserved as in the transcript; if a canonical recension is required, please have a human reviewer verify and standardize the verse wording.

Segment 4: I avoided speculative corrections where the original wording was unclear; please have a subject-matter reviewer check the archaic quotations and Sanskrit verses for authoritative spelling and diacritics if needed.
Segment 5: The Sanskrit-like fragment 'उपेक्ष्येगा' was corrected to 'उपेक्ष्येत्' with medium confidence; please verify this against the speaker's intended Sanskrit phrasing.
Segment 5: The transcript ends abruptly with 'उत्' (cut off). Preserve as-is; content is incomplete and should not be expanded without source audio.

Segment 6: Several Sanskrit phrases appear to be partially transcribed or mixed with Latin script and may need human verification: e.g., 'अथ अर्जुनस्य भगवत् उक्त वचनार्थ विवेक अनवधारण निमित्तः प्रश्नः कल्पयेत', 'मया बुद्धिकर्मणोः समुच्चय उक्तः', 'मर्थम् इत्थं त्वं भ्रान्तोऽसि इति?', and 'न तु पुनः प्रतिवचनम् अननुरूपं पृष्टात् अन्यत्'.
Segment 6: The rendering 'प्रोक्ते' was normalized from a mixed Latin/Devanagari fragment; confirm the intended Sanskrit reading (could be 'प्रोक्ता', 'उक्ते', etc.).
Segment 6: Speaker uses mixed-language quoting and transliteration; please review for exact Sanskrit canonical wording where doctrinal precision matters.
Segment 7: अशुद्धि/अस्पष्टता के संभावित स्थान जिन्हें मानव-समीक्षा चाहिए:
Segment 7: 1) 'नापि स्मार्तेन एव कर्मणा बुद्धेः समुच्चय अभिप्रेते' — संस्कृत उद्धरण असमंजसपूर्ण प्रतीत होता है; संभवतः पाठ में त्रुटि है।
Segment 7: 2) 'विभागवचनादि सर्वं न अनुपपन्नं, न उपपन्नं, न ऊपर से आएगा।' — यह वाक्य अस्पष्ट/आवाज-­आधारित गड़बड़ है; सिद्धान्तिक अर्थ बदल सकता है, मानव-समीक्षा आवश्यक है।
Segment 7: 3) 'मुमुक्षा बढ़ने का मतलब ये थोड़े है कि खेती छोड़ दें।' — 'थोड़े' शब्द ASR की वजह से गलत हो सकता है; वक्ता का आशय पुनः जाँचना चाहिए।
Segment 7: 4) 'दोनों का सहचार होना चाहिए' — 'सहचार' शब्द असामान्य है; हो सकता है कि वक्ता ने 'सहचर' या 'सहचर्य' कहा हो।

Segment 8: Several Sanskrit phrases remain verbatim from the raw transcript (e.g., 'किं च क्षत्रियस्य युद्धं स्मार्त कर्म स्वधर्मम्', 'यस्य तु अज्ञानात् रागादि दोषतो वा कर्मणि प्रवृत्तस्य', and the sequence around 'ईषणमात्रेण/ईषत्'). These are preserved but may warrant human review for precise diacritics, sandhi or classical orthography if exact canonical wording is required.

Segment 8: The speaker's corrections/hesitations around the words 'ईषण', 'ईषत्' and the comment about 'मकार आगे होने के नाते तकार का...' were left intact in their conversational form; a human reviewer may want to normalize or verify the intended Sanskrit term if a critical textual reproduction is needed.
Segment 10: Changed 'ब्रह्मा' to 'ब्रह्म' — please verify intended Sanskrit phrasing, since this can affect doctrinal nuance.

Segment 10: Left Sanskrit fragments like 'तस्य कर्मणि कर्मप्रयोजने च निवृत्ते अपि' and 'न तत् कर्म येन बुद्धेः समुच्चयः स्यात्' as in raw text; reviewers may check classical citation/orthography if needed.
Segment 10: Corrected 'प्रवृत्ति रूपम्' to 'प्रवृत्तिरूपम्' (compound form); confirm speaker's intended sandhi/spacing in Sanskritized terms.

Segment 11: Several Sanskrit terms were adjusted for orthography and compound formation (फलाभिसंधि, अहंकाराभावस्य, यथापूर्वं, तत्त्ववित्). If strict Vedic/Gītā quoting is required, please verify these forms against the exact quoted text, since small variants (sandhi, elisions like 'अजोऽपि') were left as in the raw transcript when uncertain.
Segment 12: Corrections to the English phrase ('मार्बलस ... most classical example') and to 'सामीकृते' are moderate-confidence; please verify against the original audio if exact wording is important.

Segment 12: Multiple Sanskrit phrases (e.g., तत्त्ववित्तु, आहिताग्नेः, तदेव अग्निहोत्रादि आदि) were left as in the original when their precise classical forms were uncertain; verify if stricter canonical transliteration is required.

changes.reason: Normalized the compound 'पूर्वपक्ष' (one word) as commonly used in commentary context.

changes.original: तद्वत् फलाविसंधि अहंकार अभावस्य।
changes.corrected: तद्वत् फलाभिसंधि अहंकाराभावस्य।
changes.reason: Corrected Sanskrit compound/spelling: 'फलाभिसंधि' is the standard term and combined 'अहंकाराभावस्य' as a compound for consistency.

changes.original: और फिर आगे बोलते हैं, फलाविसंधि, हाँ, अहंकार अभावस्य।
changes.corrected: और फिर आगे बोलते हैं, फलाभिसंधि, हाँ, अहंकाराभावस्य।
changes.reason: Consistent correction of the term 'फलाभिसंधि' and compound 'अहंकाराभावस्य'.

changes.original: उसके भीतर, बाहर उसको यथापूर्व प्रवृत्ति दिखती है लोगों को।
changes.corrected: उसके भीतर, बाहर उसको यथापूर्वं प्रवृत्ति दिखती है लोगों को।
changes.reason: Added visarga/anusvāra ('ं') to match the Sanskrit adverbial form 'यथापूर्वं' used earlier in the context.

changes.original: उसके भीतर फल की अभिसंधि नहीं है और अहंकार नहीं है।
changes.corrected: उसके भीतर फलाभिसंधि नहीं है और अहंकार नहीं है।
changes.reason: Made the compound form consistent with earlier corrections ('फलाभिसंधि').

changes.original: तत्त्ववित्तु, तत्त्ववित्तु नाहं करोमीति मन्यते, न च तत्फलम् अभिसन्धत्ते।
changes.corrected: तत्त्ववित्, तत्त्ववित् नाहं करोमीति मन्यते, न च तत्फलम् अभिसन्धत्ते।
changes.reason: Adjusted the Sanskrit form to 'तत्त्ववित्' (standard nominative form) from the doubled 'तत्त्ववित्तु' which appears to be an ASR duplication/spelling error.

changes.original: तत्त्ववित्तु, तत्त्ववित्तु नाहं करोमीति मन्यते,
changes.corrected: तत्त्ववित्तु, तत्त्ववित्तु नाहं करोमि इति मन्यते,
changes.reason: Separated 'करोमि' and 'इति' to reflect customary Sanskrit citation form (ASR merged them).

changes.original: नैव किंचित् करोमीति युक्तो मन्येत तत्त्ववित्।
changes.corrected: नैव किंचित् करोमि इति युक्तो मन्येत तत्त्ववित्।
changes.reason: Separated 'करोमि' and 'इति' (ASR merged them).

changes.original: ये बोलते हैं, तत्त्ववित्तु नाहं करोमीति मन्यते, न च तत्फलम् अभिसन्धत्ते।
changes.corrected: ये बोलते हैं, तत्त्ववित्तु नाहं करोमि इति मन्यते, न च तत्फलम् अभिसन्धत्ते।
changes.reason: Separated 'करोमि' and 'इति' in repeated occurrence.

changes.original: दृष्टांत देखना, मार्बलस जिसको बोलते हैं, मोस्ट क्लासिकल एग्जाम्पल,
changes.corrected: दृष्टांत देखना, जिसे 'most classical example' कहते हैं,
changes.reason: ASR likely garbled the English phrase; replaced with a clearer rendering of the spoken English phrase.

changes.original: सामीकृते, सामीकृते मने आधा कर लेने के बाद।
changes.corrected: समीकृते, समीकृते मने आधा कर लेने के बाद।
changes.reason: Corrected likely OCR/ASR vowelization of the Sanskrit term 'समीकृते'.

changes.original: वृत्ति बीच में निरंकार हो गया
changes.corrected: वृत्ति बीच में निरहंकार हो गया
changes.reason: Context (previous segment used 'निरहंकार') indicates 'निरहंकार' was intended; 'निरंकार' is likely an ASR error.

changes.original: तो उसका कर्म अकर्म होता है, न तत् कर्मा हो।
changes.corrected: तो उसका कर्म अकर्म होता है, न तत् कर्म।
changes.reason: Extra 'ा' and trailing 'हो' appear to be ASR insertion; 'न तत् कर्म।' fits the preceding discussion and grammar.
